column2: [intro]
Raise the curtain, she is here,
Dopamine puts on a show, she acts crazy,
She prances, she takes the big leap,
In our heads, she sets the fire, without a word.
Dopamine, little machine,
Who dances in our veins, oh what a tease!
We seek her, we hunt her, she electrifies us,
The dance of dopamine makes life more cunning.
Hooked to our screens, to our smartphones,
We seek dopamine like children,
In the like, the share, we get intoxicated,
But is that really what will revive us?
Dopamine, little machine,
Who dances in our veins, oh what a tease!
We seek her, we hunt her, she electrifies us,
The dance of dopamine makes life more cunning.
[ solo ]
Dopamine, our addiction,
She makes us addicted, without any restriction,
We chase after her, we always want more,
The dance of dopamine, it's our lot of suspended vices.
[outro]
